@ the block input of an instance in an arm is evaluated at block
render if_tilde_hoist.block_input_in_an_arm sr=0x41000000 params g=0x40800000 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000]
@ the init input of an instance in an arm is evaluated at init
render if_tilde_hoist.init_input_in_an_arm sr=0x41000000 cfg k=1 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000]

render if_tilde_hoist.block_input_in_the_else sr=0x41000000 params g=0x40800000 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000]
@ the block input of an instance in the arm of a chain is evaluated at block
render if_tilde_hoist.block_input_in_a_chain_arm sr=0x41000000 params g=0x40c00000 in x=[0x40400000 0x40000000 0x3f800000]

render if_tilde_hoist.block_input_in_a_nested_arm sr=0x41000000 params g=0x40800000 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000]
@ the second condition of a chain is not evaluated when the first condition of block is true
render if_tilde_hoist.second_condition_of_block sr=0x41000000 params b=true d=0 in x=[0x3f800000 0x3f800000]

render if_tilde_hoist.second_condition_of_block sr=0x41000000 params b=false d=0 in x=[0x3f800000 0x3f800000]
panic block

render if_tilde_hoist.second_condition_of_block sr=0x41000000 params b=false d=50 in x=[0x3f800000 0x3f800000]

init 0 if_tilde_hoist.block_part_in_an_arm_panics sr=0x41000000
process 0 params d=0 frames=0 in x=[]
panic block

render if_tilde_hoist.block_part_in_an_arm_panics sr=0x41000000 params d=4 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000]

init 0 if_tilde_hoist.init_part_in_an_arm_panics sr=0x41000000 cfg n=0
panic init
